description.summary: A Keyword Retriever retrieves candidates using lexical or keyword-oriented matching signals.
description.description: A Keyword Retriever is a RAG component that retrieves candidate documents or chunks by applying lexical, term-based, or keyword-oriented matching signals against a retrievable collection.

responsibilities: Retrieve candidate records using lexical or keyword-oriented matching signals.

inputs.name: Query
inputs.description: The search query used to match lexical or keyword signals.

outputs.name: Candidate ranking
outputs.description: A ranked candidate list produced by lexical or keyword-oriented matching.
